message: So, the other day, I found myself in a bit of a panic because I couldn’t remember the last time I checked my smoke alarms. I mean, I consider myself the gloriously over-prepared type, but I was starting to feel like a bit of a slacker! 😅 After a quick check, I realized I had a plan for just about everything—except checking those alarms regularly. It’s such a simple thing to do, but it makes a world of difference. Just a friendly reminder to keep those alarms fresh and your escape plans at the ready! What’s your latest little preparedness win?
